title_en: 2026 Research Reactor Experiment and Practice Program: Call for Participants
summary: The Korea Nuclear International Cooperation Foundation (한국원자력협력재단) invites interested undergraduate nuclear engineering majors in their third or fourth year, and graduate students, to apply for the 2026 Research Reactor Experiment and Practice Program. Applicants must email the participation application form and related documents by 16:00 on Tuesday, 1 December 2026. The email address and the forms are in the Foundation's recruitment notice on its NETi website, not in this notice.

translation:
[Korea Nuclear International Cooperation Foundation] Call for Participants and Promotion: 2026 Research Reactor Experiment and Practice Program

To train future professionals in the nuclear field, the Korea Nuclear International Cooperation Foundation (한국원자력협력재단) is running the "2026 Research Reactor Experiment and Practice Program", which uses research reactors in Korea and abroad.

This program is an experiment and practice course that links the AGN-201K research reactor at Kyung Hee University with the UTR-KINKI research reactor at Kindai University in Japan. It is designed so that participating students can confirm reactor physics theory through actual experiments and compare and analyse the characteristics and experimental results of different research reactors.

Participants are being recruited as set out below. Interested students are encouraged to apply.

■ Call for Participants: 2026 Research Reactor Experiment and Practice Program

Application period: Monday, 2 November 2026 to Tuesday, 1 December 2026, until 16:00

Eligible applicants: Third- and fourth-year undergraduate students majoring in nuclear engineering, and graduate students, who are interested in research related to reactor physics

Number of participants: 12

Program content:
- Online pre-training: theoretical training in reactor physics
- Domestic experiments and practice: 4–7 January 2027 / Kyung Hee University, AGN-201K
- Overseas experiments and practice: 12–15 January 2027 / Kindai University (킨키대학교), Japan, UTR-KINKI

How to apply: Submit the participation application form (참가 신청서) and related documents by email.

Recruitment notice: See NETi > 알림마당 (Notice Board) > 공지사항 (Notices).

(Note: The email address for submission is not given in this notice; please refer to the Foundation's recruitment notice. The notice spells the Japanese university both as 킨다이 and 킨키; both refer to Kindai University.)
